title: Measuring the Permission Gate: A Stress-Test Evaluation of Claude Code's Auto Mode
abstract: arXiv:2604.04978v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Claude Code's auto mode is the first deployed permission system for AI coding agents, using a two-stage transcript classifier to gate dangerous tool calls. Anthropic reports a 0.4% false positive rate and 17% false negative rate on production traffic. We present the first independent evaluation of this system on deliberately ambiguous authorization scenarios, i.e., tasks where the user's intent is clear but the target scope, blast radius, or risk level is underspecified. Using AmPermBench, a 128-prompt benchmark spanning four DevOps task families and three controlled ambiguity axes, we evaluate 253 state-changing actions at the individual action level against oracle ground truth.   Our findings characterize auto mode's scope-escalation coverage under this stress-test workload. translated_title: 测量权限门控：对 Claude Code 自动模式的压力测试评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.04978v3 公告类型：替换。摘要：Claude Code 的自动模式是首个已部署的面向 AI 编程代理的权限系统，采用两阶段对话记录分类器来拦截危险的工具调用。Anthropic 报告该系统在生产流量上的假阳性率为 0.4%，假阴性率为 17%。我们对该系统在故意设置的模糊授权场景上进行了首次独立评估，即用户意图明确、但目标范围、影响范围或风险级别未被充分指定的任务。使用 AmPermBench——一个涵盖四个 DevOps 任务家族和三个受控模糊性维度的包含 128 个提示词的基准——我们在单个操作层面、以基准真值为对照，评估了 253 个改变系统状态的操作。我们的发现刻画了自动模式在此压力测试工作负载下的范围升级覆盖情况。端到端假阴性率为 81.0%（95% 置信区间：73.8%–87.4%），远高于生产流量上报告的 17%，反映出一种根本性的……
tldr: 该论文首次对 Claude Code 自动模式权限系统进行独立压力测试评估，通过自建的 AmPermBench 基准发现在模糊授权场景下其端到端假阴性率高达 81.0%，远高于 Anthropic 在生产流量上报告的 17%。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first independent stress-test evaluation of Claude Code's auto mode permission system, using the AmPermBench benchmark to reveal an 81.0% end-to-end false negative rate on ambiguous authorization scenarios—far higher than the 17% reported on production traffic.
